status: Proposed demo ontology; requires domain-expert review

Entity.definition: An identified object in this demonstration.

Asset.definition: A physical object or geographic grouping.

Site.definition: A named grouping of demo wells; not a legal parcel.

Well.definition: A well identifier; does not imply production status or ownership.

Reservoir.definition: A modeled subsurface resource; memberships here are synthetic assertions.

Information.definition: An information artifact, record, or definition.

Observation.definition: A reported measurement with value, units, provenance and quality status. Time and measurement location remain unknown if absent.

ObservableProperty.definition: What was measured, distinct from the measured value.

Unit.definition: The unit in which a measurement is expressed.

SourceRecord.definition: An immutable reference to a row in a specific source snapshot.

SourceDataset.definition: A versioned source artifact, identified by content hash.

QualityIssue.definition: A failure of this demonstration's explicit validation rules.

rules: Every Observation has exactly one ABOUT, MEASURES, HAS_UNIT and SOURCED_FROM edge.
Every SourceRecord belongs to exactly one content-hashed SourceDataset.
Missing values are not invented; a missing temperature generates a QualityIssue, not a zero observation.
Reported negative flow is preserved but marked rejected under the toy positive-flow rule. This is not a universal physical validity judgment.
No timestamps, sensor identities, measurement depths, legal rights or economic viability are inferred.
Taxonomy edges describe classes. Domain edges describe instances. Agent memory lives in a separate database.
This is a property-graph model inspired by SOSA's separation of observations, properties and features; it is not a certified SOSA/OWL implementation.
